title: metadata: a residual picklist named only by a residual extension is refused as unreferenced; stale message
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35711 (PR #36338). The L2 nits N1 and N5 and an L1 candidate; filed by the seat. Parent: #35711.

## What happens

1. A residual picklist named only by a residual extension is still refused as unreferenced, now that #36338 registers the residual extension.
2. `packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.ts` still tells authors a top-level `objectExtensions` entry is not registered, which #36338 makes false.
3. `sameAuthoredValue` in metadata is a hand copy of the spec's `deepEqualAuthored`, with no test holding the two equal.

## To do

1. Count a reference from a registered residual extension when judging an unreferenced picklist.
2. Fix the message text.
3. Share one equality function, or pin the two equal with a test.

## Acceptance

- A residual picklist referenced only by a residual extension is accepted; the message matches what the registry does.

Blocked-by: #36338

## Grade
p3 · area:package · domain:server. A wrong refusal and a stale message.
